			news_event = { id = vie_news.4 hours = 6 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = VIE_news_sez }
			has_country_flag = VIE_sez_active
		}
		hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = VIE_news_sez }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { VIE_catch_up = 1 } } }
			news_event = { id = vie_news.5 hours = 6 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = VIE_news_paracel }
			has_war_with = CHI
		}
		hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = VIE_news_paracel }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { VIE_catch_up = 1 } } }
			news_event = { id = vie_news.11 hours = 6 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = VIE_news_developed }
			has_completed_focus = VIE_developed_nation_2045
		}
		hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = VIE_news_developed }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { VIE_catch_up = 1 } } }
			news_event = { id = vie_news.12 hours = 6 }
		}
	}
}
